# basamake — Project PRD

Minimalistic Scala LSP server ("just the bare minimum to get work done, no fancy features"), driven by the Basamake VS Code extension.

## Goals

- Go to definition and find references for Scala and Java sources in a workspace
- Consume BSP build servers: discover `.bsp/*.json`, lazily start connections, report build diagnostics
- Work from SemanticDB files when the build tool produces them, fall back to source parsing otherwise
- Cross-target navigation: from source, into dependency jars and the JDK sources

## Tech stack

- Scala 3.7.4, JDK 21+, deder build tool
- LSP: lsp4j 1.0.0; BSP client: bsp4j 2.2.0-M2
- Parsing: scalameta (Scala), javaparser (Java); os-lib, lmdbjava (dep/JDK index cache), tupson, logback

## Scope

- In: navigation (definition/references/documentSymbol), BSP diagnostics, multiple BSP servers per workspace, SemanticDB + source-parsing index, dependency/JDK symbol cache
- Out (explicitly non-goals): code completion, hover, rename, formatting, workspace symbols
